item.title: ITM Power delivers first green hydrogen from Lingen plant to customer
item.summary: ITM Power has produced and delivered its first green hydrogen from RWE’s electrolysis plant in Lingen, Germany, in what it called one of the first operational hydrogen value chains in Europe.
